messages:
elaine: Quick thread  AWS Marketplace intake in 6w. Partner security wants SSO (SAML), SCIM, and KMS/HSM covered for the listing + joint announcement. Who owns what?
kai: I can own the tech spec for SAML/SCIM and the KMS integration notes. Will include sample SAML metadata + key policy.
maya: Product needs a feature matrix (hosted/dedicated/private) and a short customer journey doc. I'll draft the matrix.
shaun: Legal: draft announcement language but avoid attestation claims (no FedRAMP, no SOC statements absent certs). I'll redline.
liam: Marketplace needs: security summary, 3 screenshots, partner contact, and a timeline. I'll collect screenshot specs from AWS.
marketplace-bizdev-bot: "Listing intake opens 2026-11-05. Upload assets by 2026-11-01."
elaine: Deliverables: (1) Tech spec (kai), (2) Announcement draft (shaun+maya), (3) Marketplace assets (liam), (4) Customer checklist + rotation notes (maya). Deadline: 2w before intake.
kai: FYI for KMS BYOK: we'll show two modes — customer-managed (AWS KMS/HSM) and Redwood-managed. Include sample YAML for key binding and a rotation migration pattern note.
maya: Can we get a concise blurb for the listing? e.g., "SAML SSO, SCIM provisioning, optional customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS/HSM)."
shaun: That reads fine but I'll tweak copy to be announcement-safe.
liam: Scheduling a quick sync with AWS marketplace for early next week. Invite incoming.\k ai: small note: BYOK rotation in Dedicated can impact KV cache; will document a zero-downtime rotation path.
elaine: Great. Kai drop the draft spec by EOD Thu, shaun/maya start announcement and checklist, liam pulls screenshot dims. Ping me if you hit blockers. :thumbsup:
